what_happened: The route command was RIGHT, but the ego drifted about 7.6 m left of the human's path, toward the median edge, and was already off-road by 10.4 s. Then, still slowing from 10.5 to 4.9 m/s, it steered right to get back toward its route and cut into actor 9, a car just ahead and to its right, hitting it with its front/side.

The route said turn RIGHT, but the policy's planned path drifted left, away from the recorded path (about 7 m off by 9.0 s), toward the adjacent lane where bus 127 was coming the other way. Still moving at about 8 m/s, the ego's front clipped the bus as it passed alongside.

The route command was RIGHT and the recorded path stayed in the right lanes, but the ego drifted left, about 7 m off the recording, toward the oncoming lanes. Its front clipped oncoming bus 127 as the bus passed down its left side.

With a RIGHT command, the ego stayed in a left lane about 7.6 m from the recorded path, which kept to the right lanes. As it slowed at the intersection it steered right, into the side of car 9 just ahead on its right, while running over the edge of the drivable area by the median.

The command was RIGHT and the recorded path bore right, but the ego held about 9 m/s and drifted left toward the lane occupied by bus 127. Its front clipped the bus as the two passed, about 7 m off the human trajectory.

The command was RIGHT and the route curved right through the intersection, but after handoff the ego kept going straight and drifted left out of the recorded lane while slowing from 12 to 7 m/s. It ended up about 7.5 m left of the human path and went off the road at the nose of the left median island. No other actor was involved: the car ahead (id 9) was over 30 m away.
